item.title: 'Huge ask': ECB explains why Brook missed out as Root returns as Test captain
item.summary: Joe Root's return as England's Test captain has caught the cricket world off guard, but the England and Wales Cricket Board deemed his seasoned experience essential for the team's current challenges. While Harry Brook is making strides as a leader of the white-ball teams, focus remains on Root to stabilize the Test side during this transitional phase. Brook is seen as a potential successor, albeit not just yet.
